working_title: Climate-adjusted surface-water changes and observation uncertainty in northwestern Bangladesh
authorization: User requests research first, then complete and finalize what code can do, and notify them before paper writing. No new manual review round requested.
assurance: exploratory, transparent secondary analysis and same-process audit
primary_period: 2000-2021 source-class analysis on its fixed common-observation footprint
supplementary_period: 2015-2024 SAR/Dynamic World analysis on its different fixed historical ever-water cohorts
new_comparison_frame: 720 stratified random pixel-month samples in four frozen district x month x JRC binary-class frames; old exposed cells excluded by original design
routes: AUTOMATED_S2_PROXY_ONLY: retain frozen spectral triage binary predictions only; every other sample stays unresolved
ASSISTED_S2_PROXY: additionally retain completed, consistent human-dated interpretations; temporal variation, uncertain dates and quality-limited samples stay unresolved
weight_formula: w_i = eligible population pixels in stratum / 30 * geodesic area of sampled pixel. Normalize within the reported frame; approximate area-time ratio estimator, not exact census area.
metrics: counts and design-weighted outcome fractions with all 720 samples retained
conditional JRC/proxy label agreement on assigned comparable support
binary-completion agreement range [known matching weight / total planned weight, (known matching + unassigned weight) / total planned weight]
2000 within-original-stratum pixel-month bootstrap replicates, seed 20261016; percentile sampling intervals, no reference-truth interpretation
unknown_policy: Unassigned or conflicting references remain missing; no zero filling, no replacement, no guessed dates, no averaging across temporal label changes.
date_policy: One human answer belongs to one actual sample_id+scene_id. Repeated dates support one pixel-month, not extra independent samples.
research_scope: Bounded methods scan with recent and foundational primary sources; not a systematic review or novelty certification.
completion_criterion: Run new analysis, reconcile prior numerical claims from original tables, audit available source hashes and inventories, run meaningful software tests, inspect new figures, freeze claim limits and provide a reproducible writing handoff.
writing_ready_definition: Evidence and computational package sufficient to begin a manuscript with the stated restricted claims and unresolved uncertainties. Does not mean publication, peer-review, or submission readiness.
excluded_claims: 100 percent accuracy or independent ground-truth accuracy
all-year or permanent/seasonal class accuracy validated by four monthly samples
climate-adjusted residuals causally identify pumping or other human effects
opposite JRC and SAR trends measured identical quantities or cancel one another
first study, proven novelty, guaranteed acceptance
